name: tool-dependency-graph
description: Infers producer/consumer dependency graphs between API tools from their JSON-schema catalogs, without hardcoding any toolkit's vocabulary.

scripts.demo:github: npm run generate -- catalogs/github.json --out dependency_graph.github.json && npm run viz -- dependency_graph.github.json visualization.github.html
scripts.demo:slack: npm run generate -- catalogs/slack.json --out dependency_graph.slack.json && npm run viz -- dependency_graph.slack.json visualization.slack.html
